locations.description: **Location:** In the elevated office at the very north west end of the Industrial Weed Grow warehouse in North Mariana County. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Industrial Weed Grow.

locations.title: Office Safe - Saber Shipping Facility
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the back office on the west side of the north building in Saber Shipping Yard off of Northbrook Drive in Little Cuba. You can climb straight into the office from the open window in the back. This office safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at the Saber Shipping Yard.

locations.title: Safe - Casa Guardia
locations.description: **Location:** Inside Casa Guardia on the second floor balcony, in the southwestern corner. The abandoned building is off of NW 3rd Ave in Little Cuba. Climb the ladder on the west side of the building and drop down from the roof access for easy access to the safe. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at Casa Guardia.

locations.title: Safe - Saber Shipping Facility
locations.description: **Location:** In the upstairs office of the Saber Shipping Facility off of Westbrook Drive in Balsero. The door at the top of the roof will lead you right to this area. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation at the Saber Shipping Facility.

locations.title: Safe - Parlor Apartments
locations.description: **Location:** In the back living area on the first floor inside the Parlor Apartments building off of Northbrook Drive in Rockridge. You can enter the apartment from the apartment building's front entrance, or through an open garage on the west side of the of the building from Northbrook Drive. From the garage, jump up through the opening in the wall, make a left, and the apartment entrance will be on your left. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Parlor Apartments.

locations.title: Office Safe - Chatfield Storage & Logistics
locations.description: **Location:** On the second floor of the site office at Chatfield Storage & Logistics on Waxman Island. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Chatfield Storage & Logistics.

locations.title: Safe - Ocean Beach Lab
locations.description: **Location:** In an office in the back of the Gabriel Wexler salon building (Ocean Beach Lab) off of Atlantic Ave in Ocean Beach. Break into the main lab room from the alley on the west side of the building to find the office on the right. This safe a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Ocean Beach Lab.

locations.title: Armory Safe - Vespucci Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** In a room on the second floor of Vespucci Mansion, overlooking the pool and canal through west-facing sliding glass doors. The room can be accessed from these sliding glass doors or the interior door. Find Vespucci Mansion off of Neptune Circle on Vespucci Island, part of the Rialto Islands. The Armory Safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Vespucci Mansion.

locations.title: Armory Safe 2 - Vespucci Mansion
locations.description: **Location:** In a room on the second floor of Vespucci Mansion, overlooking the pool and canal through west-facing sliding glass doors. The room can be accessed from these sliding glass doors or the interior door. Find Vespucci Mansion off of Neptune Circle on Vespucci Island, part of the Rialto Islands. The Armory Safe 2 is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Vespucci Mansion.

locations.title: Safe - Leonida Carrier Warehouse
locations.description: **Location:** In the corner of the backroom behind the office inside the Leonida Carrier Warehouse. Make your way to this room from the the west garage entrance, or climb the outside ladder on the southeastern side of the building to gain roof access. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Leonida Carrier Warehouse.

locations.title: Safe - Cigar Import Front
locations.description: **Location:** In the back room of the Palmis Liquor (Cigar Import Front) off Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. Break open the "Staff Only" door behind the counter. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Opertion at the Cigar Import Front.

locations.title: Safe -Janjak's Garage
locations.description: **Location:** In an office area through the north garage entrance inside Janjak's Garage, just north of Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. To be a little more stealthy, enter by climbing the ladder outside on the west side of the building and dropping down right on top of the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at Janjak's Garage.

locations.title: Safe - Illegal Sneaker Trade
locations.description: **Location:** In the back, staff-only room of Drip Drops on Del Rio Blvd in La Perle. You can break in from the front or enter through the backdoor from the alley on the east side. This safe is is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Illegal Sneaker Trade.

locations.title: Safe - Sound4Sound Studio
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the recording booth control room at the Sound4Sound Studio in Stockyard, north of Vice City. Try entering from the doors on the east side of the building for easier access, but you can also get there through the storage room with the Unique Weapon Variant in it that's to the right of the "Employee Only" entrance. This safe is a Key Valuable of the San4San Illegal Operation at the Sound4Sound Studio.

locations.title: Safe
locations.description: **Location:** In the back room through the "Staff Only" door of the 247 Gas (Gas Station Meth Front) in Emerald Springs off of CR 62. This safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Gas Station Meth Front.

locations.title: Safe - Irons Building Supply
locations.description: **Location:** In the upstairs office past the balcony gym setup in the  Irons Building Supply in Ambrosia. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Irons Building Supply.

locations.title: Office Safe - Hog Stars Garage
locations.description: **Location:** In the back office of the Hog Stars Garage, on Acacia St. in Ambrosia of Kelly County.  You can enter from an open skylight on the roof by climbing a ladder on the southwestern side of the building. Beware of dogs, though. Once inside, go left through the opening beneatht the Live and Ride Another Day banner to find the office entrance on the left. This office safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Hog Stars Garage.

locations.title: Safe - Biker Hideout
locations.description:
**Location:** In the restricted back room in the northwest part of The Thirsty Wolf, a Biker Hideout, on SR-27 in the north part of Belville. You can break directly into this room from out back--the safe is on the right from this door. 
This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Biker Hideout.

locations.title: Safe - Farm Fix Meth Lab
locations.description: **Location:** In the back corner of the second floor office in the southeastern part of the the Farm Fix Meth Lab off of Chastity Ave in the rural, northern part of Belville. You can try climbing up the AC unit on the north side of the building, then dropping down the southeastern most skylight on top of the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Final Chapter Illegal Operation at the Farm Fix Meth Lab.

locations.title: Office Safe - Kingpin Bowling
locations.description: **Location:** In a back office, found through a "Storage" door, in the northeastern part of the abandoned Kingpin Bowling alley, off US-9 in Port Gellhorn. You can also find the safe by climbing a ladder on the east side of the building, then dropping down an open latch with a ladder. This drops you right next to the office. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at Kingpin Bowling.

locations.title: Locked Safe - Backroom Weed Front
locations.description: **Location:** In the back room of the Pearl House Hair Salon in the southern part of Port Gelhorn. Break into the back room from the west side of the building. This safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Backroom Weed Front.

locations.title: Safe - June Warehouse
locations.description: **Location:* Beside the fridge in the south part of June Warehouse off of US-9 and Glenwood Ave in Port Gellhorn. Enter from the side door on the south side of the building to find it immediately to your left. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at June Warehouse.

locations.title: Lieutenant Room Safe - La Cascara Motel
locations.description: **Location:**  Inside a protected room, from the northwest door outside, on the top floor on the northwest side of the abandoned La Cascara Motel, on the beach in Port Gellhorn. Climb the staircase at the northern part of the building, and make sure to bring sticky bombs to open the way. The Lieutenant Room Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at La Cascara Motel.

locations.title: Office Safe - Brooks Boatworks
locations.description: **Location:**  Inside an office on the second story of the fishery building at the north end of Port Gellhorn. This room is accessible from outside, not inside the fishery itself. You can sneak straight into this room through an open window by going up the outdoor stairs on the northeast side of the building, then jumping up onto the roof. This Office Safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at Brooks Boatworks.

locations.title: Warehouse Safe - Brooks Boatworks
locations.description: **Location:** In an office upstairs inside the main Brooks Boatworks warehouse, located in the northern part of Port Gellhorn off of Gellhorn Ave. Find the particular stairs that lead to the office by entering from the shudder doors on the southeastern side of the building and looking to the left.

locations.title: Safe - Stash House
locations.description: **Location:** Just past the kitchen inside the stash house on Gellhorn Ave in Port Gellhorn. While facing the front of the house from Gellhorn Ave, enter through the side door on the right (south side) of the house straight into the kitchen. The safe is on your right just past the doorway by the fridge. This safe is a Key Valuable of the Kolt & Associates Illegal Operation at the Stash House.

locations.title: Locked Safe - Walker Farm
locations.description: **Location:** By the computers just inside the main north entrance beneath the awning of the main Walker Farm building. Find the rural farm off of SR-32 in Frogswater, between Ambrosia and Port Gellhorn. There's an opening in the perimeter fence on the east side. Use the trailers by the fence there to jump up and over a gap in the fence missing the barbed wire. The Locked Safe is a Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at Walker Farm.

locations.title: Safe - Weed Grow
locations.description: **Location:** In an office just inside the southwestern entrance of the largest warehouse at M7's Weed Grow in Tallaloko. This safe is a Key Valuable of the M7 Illegal Operation at the Weed Grow.

locations.title: RV Safe - Weed Grow
locations.description: Location: In an RV on the northwest side of the compound at M7's Weed Grow in Tallaloko. This RV safe is a Key Valuable of the M7 Illegal Operation at the Weed Grow.

locations.title: Locked Safe - Carter Mining Boathouse
locations.description: **Location:** Just inside to the left of the main southeastern entrance to the Carter Mining Boathouse. This locked safe is the Key Valuable of the Illegal Operation at the Carter Mining Boathouse.
